name: Build any percent
rule: Make a harder percent from the easy ones. 5% is half of 10%. 15% = 10% + 5%. 20% is two 10%s. 35% = 25% + 10%. 75% is three quarters.
why: Tips, tax and discounts are almost always 5%, 10%, 15%, 20% or 25%. If you can build them from 10% and a quarter, you never need a calculator.

clues: Which easy percents add up to this one? Start with 10%.
10% of {n} is {ten}. 5% of {n} is {five}. A quarter of {n} is {quarter}. Now add the pieces you need.
